tasks.label: Dev: turbo (all workspaces)
args: repo="${workspaceFolder}"; pids="$(pgrep -f "$repo/.+turbo run dev" || true; pgrep -f "$repo/.+next dev -p 3000" || true; pgrep -f "$repo/.+tsx.+src/server.ts" || true)"; pids=$(echo "$pids" | sed '/^$/d' | sort -u); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "[dev-task] kill old dev pids -> $pids"; echo "$pids" | xargs kill -9; fi; for p in 3000 4000; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$p || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "[dev-task] kill :$p -> $pids"; echo "$pids" | xargs kill -9; fi; done; pnpm dev
